About Us
Founded in 1987 by two seasoned industry visionaries, Tri-Vin Imports Inc. embarked on a journey driven by a shared passion for wine. Their mission was simple yet profound: to unearth and promote premium quality, high-value wines from every corner of the globe.
As a premier national importer and distributor, Tri-Vin Imports is a powerhouse in the industry. We take pride in introducing the public to unique, exquisite wines while offering unparalleled customer service to retailers, wholesalers, and distributors alike. Our commitment to building close relationships with wine producers is matched by our dedication to innovative marketing strategies that ensure their products shine brightly in a crowded marketplace.
Our team is comprised of skilled and knowledgeable wine professionals who are as passionate about quality as they are about their craft. This expertise enables us to curate a world-class selection, particularly our acclaimed collection of Portuguese wines. As our founder Joao Oliveira, proudly stated, "We offer the single best collection of Portuguese wines available in the entire US."
Under the leadership of our CEO, Marc Oliveira, and with our new name, Tri-Vin Wines and Spirits, our family business has proudly entered its second generation. For over three decades, we've upheld a legacy of excellence and passion. Tri-Vin Wines and Spirits, we don't just sell wine; we share stories, experiences, and the essence of the world's finest vineyards. Join us to elevate your wine journey today.

1822 Southwest 2nd Street Pompano Beach, FL 33069 PH 954.861.2520 | FX 954.861.2521 05/22 Since 1999, Winebow has served the state of Florida with an unmatched level of experience and knowledge in importing and wholesale distribution of fine wine and spirits. By bringing together best practices and resources in our company, Winebow’s financial strength, operational expertise, extended reach, and focus on education provide a unique platform and an unparalled level of service in the fine wine and spirits sector.
With a distribution network in 19 markets that comprise 65% of all U.S. wine consumption, including 8 of the top 10 consuming markets, Winebow strives to be the best partner to its customers and suppliers, and to inspire a passion for fine wine and spirits nationwide.
Our comprehensive portfolio is hand-selected to meet the market’s needs. We represent some of the most established, family-owned properties, as well as a new generation of winemakers and distillers who are dedicated to innovation and quality. Their stories are unique and diverse, their approach is hands-on, and some have family histories dating back for generations.
We are proud to preserve our import and domestic shipments in 100% temperature-controlled conditions from country of origin to our customers. Our temperature-controlled warehouse and delivery vehicles ensure product quality is maintained. We offer flexible ordering hours with a late 5pm order cutoff, no broken case or bottle fees, no delivery charge which encompasses the entire state of Florida.
Through the integration of knowledge, scale and operational excellence, Winebow has created an unprecedented organization for fine wine and spirits beverage distribution. We hold the words “customer service” in very high regard and our value proposition remains in the quality of our sales consultants who boast an average of over 15 years of industry expertise; the dynamic portfolio we represent; and our dedication to earning your business!

Abbazia di Novacella
Abbazia di Novacella
The Abbey of Novacella can safely be considered as a kind of Temple of Viticulture of the Isarco Valley: here it has been producing wine for centuries, since 1142. The centuries-old experience, combined with the latest technologies and the passion of those who collaborate in the vineyard and cellar, make the wines of the Abbey of Novacella rich in personality and character. Are the altitude is between 600 and 900 meters, the cool climate and the mineral wealth to make this land ideal for the optimal development of the aroma and flavor of the typical white wines of the Valle Isarco as the Sylvaner, Müller Thurgau, Kerner, Gewürztraminer and Veltliner. Today the Abbey has 25 hectares of property, but controls and vinifies the grapes coming from the 50 hectares of the members of the cooperative, its exclusive suppliers. In Novacella the vinification and refining of white wines take place, while in Cornaiano there is another company headquarters where the red grapes converge. The control of The Grapes of the partners and the dedication with which for centuries the Abbey has dedicated itself to the production of wines, are an absolute guarantee of the high quality of the wines produced: mineral and tasty as only the wines of South Tyrol know how to be. Acquesi Cuvage
Acquesi Cuvage
It all starts with the selection of wines, carefully selected by the winemaker or the “chef de cave”, which already while choosing wines themselves, have clear in mind what will be the cuvée final, the daughter of their skilful blend, thanks to which each Sparkling wine will express certain and peculiar characteristics. This is the starting point of what is better known as the “Classical Method”, that after the first fermentation, the addition to the wine - specifically made responding to precise parameters and, above all, the product with high levels of acidity - the “liqueur de tirage”, which is a syrup made from wine, sugar, minerals, and selected yeast, which gives rise to a second fermentation in the bottle. The stage of the “draw” for the fact is that the addition of the “liqueur de tirage”, then the “foam”, corresponding to the second fermentation in the bottle, the latter is constantly monitored by looking at the atmosphere, and more will be slow and most of the foam will be persistent and fine. At the end of the second fermentation, the wine will then continue to stay in contact with yeasts for a shorter period, during which the yeasts themselves are often put back into suspension, so as to release the typical scents characterizing the classic method to the wine. Finally, with the disgorging, are discarded, the sediment produced by secondary fermentation in the bottle, and is added to the “liqueur d'expedition”, which is determined by the sugar content of the Sparkling wine, and then the subsequent mention of Extra Brut, Brut, Dry, Extra Dry..., up to the Pas Dosé or Brut Nature, which involves the addition of a “liqueur d'expedition” in fact corresponding to the same wine to the Sparkling wine is not without the addition of sugars, thus remaining “natural”. In a few lines, here are the main productive steps of the classic method, cornerstone of the entire project “Cuvage“, which in a single word brings together the terms” cuvée “and” perlage", key word in sparkling wine production. We are in Aqui Terme, and it is here that since 2011, under the guidance of the winemaker Loris Gava, the Rosé Brut Nebbiolo d'alba DOC, The Blanc de Blancs, the “Cuvage De Cuvage” and the “Montecarlo Offshore”are born.
